violated_contract: A change that hardens a path must be reachable on the path the shipped app takes, and something must assert that it is. Proving the hardened type behaves correctly when a test constructs it does not prove production constructs it. If the production entrypoint still builds the unhardened default, an outage ships as an empty account, a fence never runs, or a composer never fires, while the suite stays green.
canonical_prevention: The production entrypoint must construct the hardened object, and a test must fail if it goes back to the unhardened default. Import reachability is not execution: the dead-code ratchet walks import/export/part and never asks whether the function is called, so an unused import satisfies it. The guard is a test that reads the production entrypoint and injects a fault through the production factory, not through a test-only composer. App/test/unit/c3_production_wiring_test.dart and app/test/unit/c3_action_items_production_wiring_test.dart fail if main.dart constructs ConversationProvider() or ActionItemsProvider() and they inject 503 through createProductionConversationProvider / createProductionActionItemsProvider onto the real pages.
